about_the_game:
Eggstinct! is a cooperative, physics-driven dinosaur adventure where you and your friends must work together to rescue fragile eggs and survive chaotic prehistoric hazards.

A Prehistoric Party Gone Wrong

Welcome to a prehistoric world where survival isn’t about teeth and claws—it’s about teamwork, coordination, and keeping those precious eggs safe! You and up to three friends become a squad of goofy, lovable dinosaurs, each with unique abilities and personalities. Your mission? Gather scattered eggs and return them to nests scattered about the environment before time, terrain, and the planet itself turn against you.

Play Together, Crack Together

Whether it’s flinging eggs across lava flows, bashing through collapsing caves, or soaring over geysers, Eggstinct! thrives on chaotic cooperation. Every run is a comedy of survival—full of triumph, disaster, and laughter as you adapt to unpredictable environments and your friends’ equally unpredictable physics.

Meet the Dino Crew

  • T-Rex – Tosses eggs (and teammates) across danger zones.

  • Triceratops – Bashes through boulders and carries multiple eggs.

  • Spinosaurus – Swims effortlessly through rivers and rapids.

  • Pterodactyl – Glides short distances while clutching fragile cargo.

Each dino brings new strategies and surprises, making every team combo feel fresh and frantic.

Survive Wild, Ever-Changing Worlds

Traverse lush jungles, volcanic islands, storm-tossed beaches, and more! Every biome features randomly generated puzzles, challenges, environmental traps, and unique egg types with surprising properties. You’ll need to adapt, improvise, and evolve your teamwork to bring every egg home intact.

Built for Chaos. Designed for Laughter.

Eggstinct! is all about momentum, mayhem, and memorable moments. Each mission tests your timing, coordination, and creative problem-solving through dynamic physics and reactive environments. Failure is hilarious, and success feels like a prehistoric miracle.

From a New Studio with Ancient Ambition

Eggstinct! is being created by Manaforce Studios, a small but mighty startup collective of veteran game developers and designers who love building games that celebrate creativity and collaboration. With roots in AAA and indie production alike, the team is crafting Eggstinct! as their first original title!

Help Us Hatch Something Bigger

We’re currently building Eggstinct! independently while pursuing the right publishing partner to help us bring our vision to players worldwide. Your Steam wishlist directly helps us reach that goal—showing publishers and investors that players are excited for our game.

As a thank-you, everyone who wishlists Eggstinct! will receive exclusive Day-1 in-game goodies at launch—fun cosmetic surprises to celebrate being part of the flock from the start.

Wishlist now and join us on our journey to make something truly EGGCEPTIONAL!
